label: ja
alt: One adult blue bird points one wing to its OWN chest, other wing to its nest beside it. Alone at its home.
note: I = ja. Hovorím o sebe. Modrý vtáčik ukazuje na seba a svoj domov.

label: ty
alt: Blue bird speaker on left points to ONE orange adult listener on right and the orange listener's nest. Clear conversational gesture toward listener.
note: You = ty. Hovorím k jednému človeku. Modrý vtáčik oslovuje oranžového.

label: vy
alt: Blue bird speaker on left addresses TWO orange and violet adult birds on right, points to their two nests. Addressed group clearly separate from speaker.
note: You = vy. Hovorím k viacerým ľuďom. Po anglicky je you rovnaké pre ty aj vy.

label: on
alt: Blue narrator in foreground points toward ONE male orange adult bird wearing a work cap fixing a wooden bench farther away.
note: He = on. Hovorím o mužovi, ktorý pracuje.

label: ona
alt: Blue narrator in foreground points toward ONE female violet adult bird wearing a scarf gardening with watering can farther away.
note: She = ona. Hovorím o žene, ktorá pracuje.

label: my
alt: Blue bird pointing to own chest while collaborating WITH orange adult bird building a wooden bench together, both actively working.
note: We = my. Ja aj niekto ďalší pracujeme spolu.

label: oni / ony
alt: One blue narrator separate in foreground points to THREE adult orange green violet birds beside their three nests across a garden.
note: They = oni / ony. Hovorím o iných ľuďoch. Ja do tejto skupiny nepatrím.

label: moje
alt: ONE blue adult bird pointing to its own chest and holding its own large ring of keys prominently.
note: My keys = moje kľúče. Patria mne.

label: tvoje / vaše
alt: Blue speaker points toward orange listener beside listener's small green car, orange listener holds car key. Car and owner dominate.
note: Your car = tvoje auto / vaše auto. Patrí tomu, koho oslovujem.

label: jeho
alt: Blue narrator points to male orange bird wearing his distinctive green coat. Coat clearly belongs to orange bird.
note: His coat = jeho kabát. Patrí mužovi, o ktorom hovorím.

label: jej
alt: Blue narrator points toward female violet bird in scarf holding her own orange phone prominently, screen blank.
note: Her phone = jej telefón. Patrí žene, o ktorej hovorím.

label: náš
alt: Blue and orange adult birds standing together at entrance of shared cozy birdhouse, blue points to BOTH of them and shared home.
note: Our home = náš domov. Patrí mne aj niekomu ďalšiemu.

label: ich
alt: Separate blue narrator points toward TWO orange violet adult birds each holding own travel bag. Bags prominent.
note: Their bags = ich tašky. Patria iným ľuďom.

label: ja
alt: ONE blue adult bird points to its own chest with wing while using hammer to work at bench. Clearly self referring.
note: I = ja. Hovorím o sebe. Ja pracujem.

label: ty / vy
alt: Blue speaker watches and points to orange adult listener using hammer working at wooden bench. Speaker is not working.
note: You = ty / vy. Hovorím k tomu, kto pracuje.

label: ona
alt: Blue narrator points toward female violet adult bird in scarf beside her own leafy nest, female indicates her nest.
note: She = ona. Hovorím o žene a jej domove.
